did: Tested live in the browser pane by hand. The cash-on-delivery side: a delivered order that was paid for on arrival was sent back to the seller by the owner, and the buyer's page was read afterwards.

checks.text: Cash on delivery: nothing had been paid online, so nothing is refunded and the buyer's page says "Nothing to pay for this order." (this was wrong before and was fixed)
The seller's record counts it as sent back, so no commission is taken for it

notes: Only the cash-on-delivery half was shown. The online half (refund from the held money) needs a real card or wallet payment, and the test gateway only makes practice payments that never touch an order's money, so it was not shown. The code does mark a really paid order Refund due and tells the office; this is covered by automatic tests only.

shots.caption: Buyer: returned cash-on-delivery order, nothing to pay
